answer: A bonded sponsorship gate guards the haven: a newcomer joins only on a sponsor's locked 100 credits, each sponsorship naming its sponsor. The record grows like a juniper: idle reputation decays 5% each epoch, so parked identities bleed and liable sponsors lose bond and rights on fraud. Named failure mode: sponsor rental, a rented sponsor forfeits its bond on any caught identity, so across an ocean of applicants the k-th fake needs a fresh sponsor and 100 credits; 1,000 fakes lock 100,000 credits, no bulk discount. One honest newcomer pays one bond, keeps full standing.
